content.title: McDonald’s KPop Demon Hunters meals launch today: Huntrix Meal, Demon Sauce and Saja Boys menu revealed
content.text: SynopsisHuntrix Mcdonald's meal: McDonald's is celebrating the KPop Demon Hunters film with themed meals inspired by the rival groups, Huntr/X and the Saja Boys. Available from March 31, these limited-edition options include unique fries, sauces, and collectible photocards. A special Derpy McFlurry also joins the lineup, offering fans a taste of the movie's Korean-inspired flavors.ReutersHuntrix Mcdonald's mealHuntrix Mcdonald's meal: Fans of KPop Demon Hunters now have a new way to experience the story beyond the screen. Starting Tuesday, March 31, McDonald’s is turning the film’s iconic rivalry into a real-world event with themed meals inspired by Huntr/X and the Saja Boys.The fast-food chain is offering two limited-edition options, each tied to one of the groups, complete with collectible photocards and a special Derpy the Tiger access card, as per a report. The QR code on the card unlocks exclusive content through the McDonald’s app, adding an interactive layer for fans. Huntrix Meal: What’s Inside the Huntrix McDonald’s MealThe huntrix meal is built around a 10-piece Chicken McNuggets combo. It includes a medium drink, Ramyeon McShaker Fries, and two signature sauces.The fries are seasoned with soy, garlic, sesame, and spice, inspired by the characters’ favorite noodle snack. The meal also features hunter sauce mcdonald’s, described as a sweet chili sauce with notes of garlic and pepper, along with demon sauce mcdonald’s, a bold mustard sauce with heat and tang, colored purple to match the film’s demon patterns, as per a USA Today report.This huntrix mcdonald's meal is designed to reflect the energy and flavor of the trio’s on-screen world.Saja Boys Breakfast Meal Adds a Rival OptionFor fans of the opposing group, McDonald’s is also offering a breakfast-themed option. The Saja Boys meal includes a Sausage McMuffin with Egg topped with a Spicy Saja Sauce, along with hashbrowns and a small soft drink.Together, these meals form the full mcdonalds kpop demon hunters meal lineup, giving fans a choice depending on which side they support.McDonald’s KPop Demon Hunters Menu Inspired by Korean FlavorsAccording to Netflix’s chief marketing officer Marian Lee, "With McDonald's, we were able to turn the rivalry between The Saja Boys and Huntr/X into something fans can actually experience, drawing inspiration from Korean culture and food traditions that sit at the heart of the film," as quoted by USA Today. From Ramyeon-inspired fries to uniquely flavored sauces and drinks, every detail draws from Korean culture and food traditions featured in the film.Derpy McFlurry Joins the K Pop Demon Hunters McDonalds LineupThe collaboration also introduces the Derpy McFlurry, inspired by Derpy the Tiger. The dessert blends vanilla soft serve with berry-flavored popping pearls and a wild berry sauce, reflecting the playful personality of the character.As part of the full k pop demon hunters mcdonalds experience, the dessert adds a lighter, fun option alongside the themed meals.McDonalds KPop Demon Hunters Release Date and AvailabilityAll items in the mcdonalds kpop demon hunters collection, including meals and the Derpy McFlurry, are available starting March 31 at participating locations nationwide.FAQsWhat is the McDonald’s KPop Demon Hunters meal?It’s a limited-time menu inspired by the KPop Demon Hunters film, featuring themed meals and collectibles.When are the KPop Demon Hunters meals available?They launched on March 31 at participating McDonald’s locations.
